```text
ok - plain image paths keep their existing clipboard URI
ok - reserved characters are encoded rather than interpreted as URI syntax
ok - spaces are encoded in clipboard paths

Move the picture branch's clipboard copy below its success notification in `bin/omarchy-transcode`:

```sh
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('bin/omarchy-transcode')
lines = p.read_text().splitlines(keepends=True)
i = lines.index('    transcode_picture "$input" "$format" "$resolution" "$output"\n')
assert lines[i + 1] == '    copy_to_clipboard "$output"\n'
lines.insert(i + 3, lines.pop(i + 1))  # copy now runs after the success notification
p.write_text(''.join(lines))
PY
```
